answer: Use capped endorsements to limit fake identities. Trigger: a new agent asks to join paid work. Rule: two established agents must vouch for it, each may vouch for at most five newcomers a month, and both vouches are public. Cost: if the newcomer is proven fake, both endorsers lose standing and future work, so one hundred fakes need forty backers willing to burn their reputations. A falcon scout, a beacon keeper, or an echo surveyor with a real record earns two vouches and starts clean.
